commands: cd /workspace/cdk_app && npx cdk synth ec2-multiregion-QARoles-us-east-1 --json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Resources | keys[]' | grep -i subnet | head -20

for template in /workspace/cdk_app/cdk.out/*.template.json; do echo "=== $(basename $template) ===" jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | .key' "$template" done

# Get mapping of logical IDs to physical IDs for each stack declare -A subnet_map declare -A stack_regions # Stacks and their regions stacks=( "ec2-multiregion-QARoles-us-east-1:us-east-1" "ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1:us-east-1" "ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1:us-west-1" "ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2:us-west-2" ) for stack_info in "${stacks[@]}"; do stack="${stack_info%:*}" region="${stack_info##*:}" echo "=== Stack: $stack (Region: $region) ===" aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources \ --stack-name "$stack" \ --region "$region" \ --query 'StackResources[?ResourceType==`AWS::EC2::Subnet`].[LogicalResourceId,PhysicalResourceId]' \ --output text done

# Check network interfaces in each subnet declare -A region_subnets region_subnets["us-east-1"]="subnet-926bca3c subnet-76abec17" region_subnets["us-west-1"]="subnet-0ce19483" region_subnets["us-west-2"]="subnet-2e3fc9fe" echo "Checking for empty subnets..." echo "" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" subnets="${region_subnets[$region]}" for subnet_id in $subnets; do eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" \ --query 'NetworkInterfaces | length(@)' \ --output text) echo " $subnet_id: $eni_count network interface(s)" done echo "" done

# Double-check all templates for subnets for template in /workspace/cdk_app/cdk.out/*.template.json; do echo "Template: $(basename $template)" jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | "\(.key): \(.value.Properties.AvailabilityZone) - \(.value.Properties.CidrBlock)"' "$template" echo "" done
# Get all enabled regions in the account aws ec2 describe-regions --all-regions --query 'Regions[?OptInStatus!=`not-opted-in`].RegionName' --output text
# Get all enabled regions in the account aws ec2 describe-regions --all-regions --region us-east-1 --query 'Regions[?OptInStatus!=`not-opted-in`].RegionName' --output text

# Check all regions for subnets regions="us-east-1 us-east-2 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-west-2 eu-west-3 eu-central-1 eu-north-1 ap-northeast-1 ap-northeast-2 ap-northeast-3 ap-southeast-1 ap-southeast-2 ap-south-1 sa-east-1 ca-central-1" empty_subnets="" for region in $regions; do echo "Checking region: $region" # Get all subnets in this region subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[].SubnetId' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$subnets" ]; then echo " No subnets in this region" continue fi for subnet in $subnets; do # Count network interfaces in this subnet eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet" \ --query 'NetworkInterfaces | length(@)' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" = "0" ]; then echo " EMPTY: $subnet" empty_subnets="$empty_subnets$region: $subnet\n" fi done done echo "" echo "=== SUMMARY OF EMPTY SUBNETS ===" if [ -z "$empty_subnets" ]; then echo "No empty subnets found in any region" else echo -e "$empty_subnets" fi

# Get details about the empty subnets echo "=== DETAILED INFORMATION ON EMPTY SUBNETS ===" echo "" regions_with_empty="us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2" for region in $regions_with_empty; do echo "Region: $region" echo "---" empty_subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[].SubnetId' --output text 2>/dev/null) for subnet in $empty_subnets; do # Check if this subnet is empty eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet" \ --query 'NetworkInterfaces | length(@)' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" = "0" ]; then # Get subnet details aws ec2 describe-subnets \ --region "$region" \ --subnet-ids "$subnet" \ --query "Subnets[0].[SubnetId,AvailabilityZone,CidrBlock,VpcId,MapPublicIpOnLaunch]" \ --output text | while read sid az cidr vpc public; do echo " Subnet: $sid" echo " AZ: $az" echo " CIDR: $cidr" echo " VPC: $vpc" echo " Map Public IP: $public" done fi done echo "" done
